notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first succeeded fully - no browser needed. robots.txt checked (standard Shopify-template disallow list; no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot mention, no blanket Disallow: /). TREE METHOD: fetched https://www.house.com.au/sitemap.xml -> sitemap-0.xml (9099 URLs) and filtered /collections/ URLs by keyword; cross-referenced against the site's own mega-menu, which is embedded server-side as Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ JSON (props.pageProps.globalData.menu) on every page - this gave the authoritative current navigation tree (headers + child links) for Bedroom & Bathroom, Living, Dining, Kitchenware, Bakeware and Knives sections. QTY METHOD: each candidate collection page also embeds __NEXT_DATA__ with props.pageProps.initialSearchspringResponse.pagination.totalResults (Searchspring-powered PLP) plus props.pageProps.pageData.title/breadcrumbs; qty = totalResults, and title/breadcrumbs were checked against the requested slug on every leaf recorded (all matched - no silent parent-total fallback observed). Rug colour/style variants found only in the sitemap (not in the currently-rendered mega-menu, e.g. black/red/orange/jute/hampton/oval/green/yellow/woollen rugs) were individually fetched, confirmed HTTP 200 with correct breadcrumb (LIVING>DECOR>RUGS>x) and non-zero totalResults, and included at MEDIUM confidence since they are not currently exposed in primary nav even though the pages are live and correct. kitchenware-kitchen-accessories-aprons, -oven-mitts and bakeware-baking-accessories-tea-towels each 301-redirect to their sibling section's equivalent URL (aprons/oven mitts consolidated under Bakeware > Baking Accessories, tea towels under Kitchenware > Kitchen Accessories) - recorded once each at the final (canonical) URL to avoid duplicate rows per rule 30. Sitemap-only 'Kids Bedroom'/'Kids Bathroom' collection URLs (kids-bedding, kids-quilt-covers, cot-bassinet-sheets, kids-nursery-bedding, kids-bath-towels, kids-bath-mats) were checked and found to 301-redirect to the parent bedroom-bathroom landing page (deprecated/merged), except kids-bedroom-kids-cushions-throws which is still live but returns 0 products and is absent from current nav - both treated as deprecated/orphaned and excluded. EXCLUDED (checked, not included): Bedroom Furniture/Beds/Mattresses/Bed Heads (Furniture), Bedroom Decor and Bedroom Accessories>Eye Masks (decor/personal-care, not textile or storage), Shop By Size bed-linen facet pages (single/double/queen/king - cross-cutting size filters over already-counted bed-linen subtypes, not a distinct category, would double-count), Bath & Body>Eye Masks/Slippers/Grooming/Massage & Wellness (personal care, not home textile), Bathroom Accessories>Scales/Toilet Brush & Holders/Soap Dispensers/Soap Dish & Holders/Bathroom Bins/Bathroom Cleaning (fixtures/cleaning tools, not storage), Dish Racks (drying tool, not storage), Oil & Vinegar Bottles and Lunch Bags & Coolers and Reusable Shopping Bags under Food Storage & Organisation (dispensing/carrying items, not home storage per storage.md rule 6/26), Cookie Jars/Bento Boxes/Kids Lunch Boxes (Kitchen & Dining, not storage), Picnic Baskets & Blankets under Outdoor Dining (mixed carrying-gear category, primary purpose is picnic transport not home storage/textile), Knife Sharpeners (tool, not storage), Coasters/Trivets/Christmas Tableware under Table Accessories (not textile), Pets sections in full (dog/cat beds, blankets, litter bedding - pet-primary products excluded per textile.md rule 18 / storage.md rule 31), all Cooking/Appliances/Gifting/Brands/Sale nav sections (no textile or storage content). No View All/Shop All/Collection/search URLs were used as recorded rows (all such parent URLs were skipped in favour of their leaf subcategories per rule 25/34).
